meta.title: Volunteer · המשך תנועה
meta.description: Join the Friday welcome team, give a guest talk or lead a workout for combat veterans after their service. Here's how.

hero.title: Be part of the team
hero.body: Our meetings happen because people give their time. There are a few ways to join in.
hero.propose: Offer a talk or a workout session

ways.title: Ways to volunteer

items.title: Welcome team
items.body: Greet people as they arrive, check them in, and help first-timers feel at home.

items.title: Guest talk
items.body: Have something to offer combat veterans in civilian life? Every Friday morning includes a guest talk.

items.title: Lead a workout
items.body: Yoga, Pilates, movement. Every Friday morning includes a movement session.

ways.message: Hi, I'd like to volunteer with המשך תנועה. How can I help?
ways.toCrm: (goes to our registration system, in Hebrew)

volunteer.title: Welcome team
steps: Send us a message on WhatsApp.
Someone from our team gets back to you.
Before meetings you get a personal link, and for each one you choose whether you're coming.

propose.title: Talks and workout sessions
steps: Fill in a few details about your proposal (the form is in Hebrew).

closing.title: Want to see what it's like first?
